subject: Se/Demo coordination for Acme Retail — technical deep-dive

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: SE/Demo coordination for Acme Retail — technical deep-dive

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for taking the initial call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a technical demo led by our Solutions Engineering team to cover:
- Architecture and integration patterns for the Redwood inference runtime
- Security/compliance controls (audit logs, KMS/HSM integrations, VPC/private deployments)
- Performance and quantization options relevant to your latency targets

Alex (SE) and Vivek (technical AE) are copied. Proposed slot options (Pacific time):
- Thu 19 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred — includes time for Q/A)
- Thu 19 Mar, 15:00–16:00 PT
- Fri 20 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PT

Please let us know which works and any additional stakeholders to include (procurement/security). I attached a short demo deck and SOC2 summary for context.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: SE-demo-deck-Acme-v1.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SE/Demo coordination for Acme Retail — technical deep-dive

Thanks Marissa — happy to lead the session. Quick note on agenda and prep:
- 20 min architecture deep-dive (model hosting, KV cache, batching strategies)
- 20 min security & compliance Q/A (Rachel should join on specific questions)
- 20 min live demo + integration checklist

If the team can share a couple of sample prompts or an expected QPS/latency envelope ahead of time, I can tailor the demo.

Samir, if procurement/security will join, looping in Rachel Kim from our security team so we can answer compliance questions.

— Alex
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Alex.martinez@redwood.com

Hi Marissa / Alex —

Thanks — Thu 19 March looks good in principle. A couple of notes from our side:
1) Procurement needs visibility on licensing and deployment modes; they prefer 15:00–16:00 PT so our procurement lead can join.
2) Our security lead (Priya) can be there for the compliance section but will need the SOC2 summary and any third-party audit artifacts in advance (thanks for the SOC2 PDF).
3) We also have two backend engineers who want to attend for the integration discussion — names: Ramesh Patel and Erin Zhao.

So could we do Thu 19 Mar, 15:00–16:00 PT? If Alex can adjust agenda to allow procurement questions earlier in the session that would help.

Samir
IT Director, Acme Retail
